whole_board_reference_survey.interpretation: Inherited geometric coverage review items; neither native DRC violations nor confirmed electrical faults. No automatic exceptions.

decision.status_note: No R186 PCB adoption. Four-part swap preparations fit but do not restore the complete comparator path. Diagnostic signal routes in D break CAM_BAT_OUT/3V3 and split GND. Source-wide review newly exposes 81 inherited mapped-reference coverage items across 38 nets; these are review items, not confirmed faults. Canonical remains 19 opens and 6 transition flags.
decision.local_space_finding: The UPS/comparator/adjacent power area is locally congested. A movable-part pair can fit while its required feeds, signal outlets and return channels remain inaccessible. No finite screen proves global unroutability or that a 70x40 outline is sufficient.
decision.outline_direction: R182 70x40 direction question remains unanswered and unadopted; current 70x35 outline, four mounts and all interfaces stay fixed.

candidates.A: Reject: 21 other native DRC items plus old/new reference deficits.
candidates.B: Preparation only: tiny reverse bends and three source net groups not restored; 23 opens.
candidates.C: Preparation only: smoother pair traces and fixed R1704-U1702 branch retained; 22 opens, two dangling items, WHEEL_VM/current OUT/comparator input not restored.
candidates.D: Reject: routes from diagnostic search restore two moved terminals but lose seven power screens and split GND into 153+2 pads; comparator input still open.

decision.next_step: Continue from canonical R181C. Require all terminal escape paths before choosing a pair position. If pursuing this swap, jointly restore the actual CAM_BAT_OUT/3V3/GND corridors and include the R1704/U1702 input branch and obstructing neighboring control paths. Do not repeat the unchanged fixed-placement searches or accept power-reservation omission as a waiver. Review the inherited reference queue by circuit, starting with IMU_SCL, comparator input and sensing nodes.
tool_corrections: Direct original GND trace starts can lie inside a pad away from its centre; an exact in-pad source exit is now supported and checked with six positive/negative controls.
A terminal graph walk can include a shared fixed branch. C retains the original R1704-U1702 branch instead of treating it as a disposable R1703-only tail.

Initial independent R1102/C1102 pose ordering used comparator distance; pair selection correctly evaluates filter distance to U1001. No initial independent ranking is an electrical placement decision.
Pair evaluation was accelerated by distributing intersection over union and taking minimum distance over foreign shapes; original partial process/log retained. Native DRC remains independent.

The initial local-copper query used GetWidth without a via layer and emitted an assertion warning; do not use those via widths as authoritative padstack evidence. Native per-layer snapshots govern designs.
